cost_and_hurdle.capital_model: equal notional opposite perpetual positions with 2x leverage per leg require total capital equal to one leg notional before venue buffers
cost_and_hurdle.current_hurdle_source: latest nonmissing DGS3MO observation available before the frozen end
cost_and_hurdle.hurdle_rule: each primary asset and the equal-weight primary basket must have positive basis-inclusive after-cost annualized return above DGS3MO

accepted_scoped_public_candidate_only_wh: BTC and ETH each have positive archived gross funding spread APR in 2024 2025 and the 2026 pre-extension slice
BTC and ETH each have at least 95 percent complete hourly Hyperliquid funding coverage and exact Binance funding event coverage in the extension
BTC and ETH each remain positive after actual cross-venue basis drift and the frozen 20 bps total round trip cost
BTC and ETH each and their equal-weight basket exceed the latest DGS3MO annual hurdle
the conclusion does not depend on SOL or DOGE being discarded after observing the extension

economics.basis_pnl_identity: for equal-notional short Hyperliquid and long Binance perpetuals the extension basis PnL fraction is entry_HL_minus_Binance_premium minus exit_HL_minus_Binance_premium
economics.funding_identity: daily funding spread equals the sum of actual Hyperliquid hourly funding rates minus the sum of actual Binance funding events; positive means short Hyperliquid long Binance collects
economics.market_direction_dependency: equal notional opposite perpetual legs remove first-order coin direction but retain basis venue liquidation collateral and operational risk
economics.static_after_cost_return: sum extension funding spread plus basis PnL minus 0.0020
economics.static_annualization: static after-cost return divided by exact elapsed days multiplied by 365

prior_evidence.frozen_primary_selection: The archived paper's tradeable cost and capital construction explicitly pools ETH and BTC; they are selected before the new extension. SOL and DOGE remain mandatory reported controls.
prior_evidence.paper_title: The Funding Carry and a Cross-Venue Spread on Perpetual Futures: A Significance-Tested Study of Hyperliquid and Centralized Venues
